pr_body:
This PR adds a staleness-check to `AccountRLP`, _before_ checking the bloom-filter and potentially going directly into the disklayer. 

Fixes #27254

issue_context.title: flaw in snapshot difflayer lookup
issue_context.body:
We have a flaw iin how the snapshot logic works, and that is also the culprit behind the occasional strange test-errors on `TestDiffLayerExternalInvalidationPartialFlatten`, 
```
    snapshot_test.go:231: stale reference returned account: 0x0 (err: <nil>)
    snapshot_test.go:234: stale reference returned storage slot:  (err: <nil>)
```
Example on how the flaw can be triggered: have a layer `2`, which relies on layer `1`, and disk layer is `0`. Now, the layer `1` may become stale. So if we ask layer `2` about something, and it needs to consult the parent-hierarchy, we expect it to ask `1`, notice that it is `stale`, and then error out with "parent is stale". 

However, we also have a bloom filter in `2`. And the bloom filter may indicate "this doesn't exist in the memory-parent-hierarchy", so the `2` instead does the lookup directly into `0` -- the disk layer. Meaning, it totally bypasses the stale layer. And that's why we hit this error. The reason we only hit it occasionally is because the bloom filter isn't deterministic

    bloomAccountHasherOffset = rand.Intn(25)

With this diff, I can reproduce it reliably: 
```diff
diff --git a/core/state/snapshot/snapshot_test.go b/core/state/snapshot/snapshot_test.go
index 249da10aa6..802ae55583 100644
--- a/core/state/snapshot/snapshot_test.go
+++ b/core/state/snapshot/snapshot_test.go
@@ -185,6 +185,7 @@ func TestDiskLayerExternalInvalidationPartialFlatten(t *testing.T) {
 // be returned with junk data. This version of the test retains the bottom diff
 // layer to check the usual mode of operation where the accumulator is retained.
 func TestDiffLayerExternalInvalidationPartialFlatten(t *testing.T) {
+	bloomDestructHasherOffset, bloomAccountHasherOffset, bloomStorageHasherOffset = 14, 24, 5
 	// Create an empty base layer and a snapshot tree out of it
 	base := &diskLayer{
 		diskdb: rawdb.NewMemoryDatabase(),
```
```
$ go test ./core/state/snapshot -run "Diff.*PartialFlatten" -v 
=== RUN   TestDiffLayerExternalInvalidationPartialFlatten
    snapshot_test.go:232: stale reference returned account: 0x0 (err: <nil>)
    snapshot_test.go:235: stale reference returned storage slot:  (err: <nil>)
--- FAIL: TestDiffLayerExternalInvalidationPartialFlatten (0.00s)
FAIL
FAIL    github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/state/snapshot     0.052s
FAIL
```

review_comments: You need to unlock before returning
